items.label: Space Saving
items.value: The blanket ladder is 51.9 inches high and 18.1 inches wide, suitable for placing in the corner of any room without taking up too much floor space. 5 tiers of ladder can store many blankets and quilts, which can save space effectively.

items.label: Sturdy Design
items.value: The blanket holder is made of real wood to make it sturdy and durable. The maximum weight capacity of the ladder is 50 lbs, perfect for storing multiple heavy blankets and quilts.

items.label: Multi-functional design
items.value: Our product can be used as a blanket ladder, quilt ladder, or towel ladder. It also serves as a decorative item for displaying your beautiful blankets and quilts in living room, bedroom, or bathroom.

items: Farmhouse Decor：Our blanket rack embodies the farmhouse style with its rustic finish and simple design. It brings a cozy, welcoming vibe to your home, perfect for relaxing and feeling comfortable.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: You can quickly install the ladder within 5 minutes with the detailed instruction. Once installed , it can be simply leaned against the wall for use, without the need for screwing it into the wall.

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: Storage and display of household items in various rooms
